definitions.gloss: to hand down; to pronounce; to pass (a sentence)
definitions.explanation: To officially announce a verdict, judgment, or decision, typically in legal or formal contexts.
To give an official order or directive to someone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{渡|わた}す。
⟦{裁判官|さいばんかん}→裁判官：09562_saibankan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{有罪|ゆうざい}→有罪：13003_yuuzai⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{渡|わた}した。
examples.english: The judge handed down a guilty verdict to the defendant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{余命|よめい}→余命：21080_yomei⟧⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}い{渡|わた}された。
examples.english: The doctor told me I have six months to live.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{渡|わた}された。
examples.english: I was ordered by my boss to transfer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{渡|わた}された。
examples.english: The president ordered me to resign.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{停学|ていがく}→停学：22314_teigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{渡|わた}された。
examples.english: I was given a one-week suspension by the school.

notes:
FORMS:
Compound verb: ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say) + ⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧ (to hand over).
The combination conveys officially delivering a decision to someone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{渡|わた}す - to hand down a verdict
- ⟦{刑|けい}→刑：02786_kei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{渡|わた}す - to pronounce a sentence
- ⟦{解雇|かいこ}→解雇：04561_kaiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{渡|わた}す - to deliver notice of dismissal
- ⟦{余命|よめい}→余命：21080_yomei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{渡|わた}す - to tell someone their life expectancy

COMMON PATTERNS:
The person receiving the news is usually the subject of the passive {言|い}い{渡|わた}される, with the announcer marked by ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ — this passive framing is far more common than the active form.

REGISTER:
Formal and written in style. Common in legal and official contexts.
